landing.subtitle: Enter your built-up area, floors, zone, and quality tier. Get a transparent total cost estimate with honest ranges, a 9-category breakdown, practical material recommendations, and a downloadable PDF.

allocation.title: 9-Category Cost Allocation
allocation.body: Predicts realistic cost distributions across Foundation, RCC Structure, Masonry, Openings, Flooring, Services, and Contingency.

zone.title: Pune Zone Calibration
zone.body: Accounts for local micro-market logistics and rate factors across Baner, Kothrud, Wagholi, Bavdhan, and PCMC.

ranges.title: Honest Planning Ranges
ranges.body: Displays statistical confidence intervals (P10 to P90), so you understand possible cost variations before drawings are finalized.

notice.title: Before you commit to a budget
notice.body: Keep a contingency before you commit. Site conditions, soil tests, and final architectural drawings can change costs. Land, statutory approvals, professional fees, and external works are outside these estimates.

materials.title: Choose for the way you'll live.
materials.subtitle: Practical material recommendations for your Standard-quality home in Baner, Pune.

intro.title: Spend on the things you won't want to replace.
intro.body: Structure, concealed services and waterproofing deserve care at every budget. Let tiles, hardware and decorative finishes flex with your priorities.

monsoon.title: For Pune's monsoon and summer:
monsoon.body: Ask for terrace slopes, drainage and wet-area waterproofing details. Compare shaded windows and cross-ventilation before paying for decorative upgrades.

moodboard.caption: Material study · Illustrative samples, not product specifications

materials.footnote: Each scenario includes a 5% contingency and the same emissions. Higher quality means finish and specification allowances—not a license to compromise structural safety at a lower budget.

aac.title: AAC block walling
aac.body: Lower weight than conventional brick and useful thermal performance. Needs appropriate mortar, joint treatment and experienced workmanship.
aac.note: Ask your engineer about wall thickness, fixings and lintel-pocket detailing. Compare delivered and cost/piece locally.

vitrified.title: Vitrified, not oversized
vitrified.body: Standard size vitrified tiles balance upkeep and cost. Large formats can add wastage and need flatter substrates and skilled installation.
vitrified.note: Choose slip-resistant surfaces for bathrooms and balconies. Review samples in daylight before selecting.

details.title: Details before brands
details.body: uPVC can be a low-maintenance window option. Frame quality, reinforcement, seals and installation matter as much as the material.
details.note: Check drainage paths, shading and ventilation. Gather written specifications and warranties with your vendor.

disclaimer.title: A recommendation is not a purchase specification:
disclaimer.body: No supplier stock or availability is claimed. Obtain local quotations, verify codes, certifications, installation details and suitability with your architect or engineer before ordering.

methodology.title: Estimation Methodology & Data Strategy
methodology.subtitle: Learn how BuildSmart AI models residential construction costs, allocates 9-category breakdowns, and maintains provenance without fabricating market data.

engine.title: Estimation Engine Architecture
engine.bodyAfter: from primary architectural attributes: total built-up area, number of floors, Pune micro-zone location multiplier, and selected quality tier. It produces an indicative median estimate (P50) alongside 80% empirical quantile bounds (P10 to P90).

data.title: Data Strategy & Provenance Tags
data.intro: In strict accordance with project honesty rules, every record in our datasets carries explicit provenance metadata:

tags.realBody: Actual completed Pune residential projects used exclusively for gold evaluation holdout.
tags.publishedBody: Rates derived from published municipal Schedule of Rates (SoR) and verified CPWD/PMC publications.
tags.syntheticBody: Transparently labeled noise augmentation for range bounds validation (never presented as real).

scope.title: Scope Boundaries & Professional Disclaimer
scope.body: BuildSmart AI provides preliminary planning guidance for Pune residential builds. It is strictly not a replacement for professional civil/structural calculations, architectural working drawings, soil tests, or binding contractor quotations.
